title: Visa Category Selection
description: Identify the specific non-immigrant visa category that matches the applicant's purpose of travel.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa guidance specialist. Help the applicant identify the correct non-immigrant visa category based on their travel purpose. Be clear and precise.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.hint: Applicant's full name as it appears on their passport.

fields.label: Purpose of Travel
fields.hint: Briefly describe why the applicant is traveling to the United States.

fields.label: Visa Type
fields.hint: Select the correct non-immigrant visa type based on the travel purpose.

fields.label: Intended Duration of Stay
fields.hint: How long does the applicant plan to stay in the US? (e.g., '3 weeks', '6 months')

completion_message: Visa category confirmed. Proceed to complete the DS-160 Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application form.
